name: Charges Details 2
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

OtherChargesType.name: Other Charges Type
OtherChargesType.definition: Specifies the type of charge by means of a code.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money asked or paid for the charge.

TypeOrOtherChargesTypeRule.definition: If Type is present, then OtherChargesType is not allowed. If Type is not present, then OtherChargesType is mandatory.
